newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys two diesel, one SKO cargo for March.
newsitem.headline: India buys two diesel, one SKO cargo for March.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded two 0.5-percent sulphur diesel cargoes and one kerosene cargo for March delivery in two tenders, industry sources said on Tuesday.
IOC bought the kerosene cargo from Kuwait Petroluem Corp (KPC) at $34 per tonne over prevailing spot Mediterranean quotes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to the Indian east coast.

One diesel cargo was awarded to KPC at 65 cents over spot MidEast quotes on a free-on-board Kuwait basis while the second cargo was awarded to BB Energy at $2.09 over MidEast quotes on a c-and-f basis, sources said.
IOC had already bought 615,000-tonnes of diesel for March arrival in its first tender.
